verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email as its own message type, separate from broadcasts and sequences, intended for receipts, password resets and login codes. It can be sent via the CLI. However, nothing in the pack shows it separating suppression or reputation from marketing, or delivering to unsubscribed contacts, and templates appear shared across sends. Missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends bypass marketing unsubscribes, separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation/IP pool for transactional, transactional-specific templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
